Granulomatous Mastitis: Frozen section of specimen: granulomatous inflammation
Microscopic examination of tumor: fibrous and lymphoid tissue infiltrated by large epithelioid granulomas with central acellular necrosis and many giant cells
Special (acid fast) stains: no microorganisms within necrosis
Sentinel lymph node: 0.9 cm in greatest diameter, same morphologic appearance as tumor
Physical examination finding: skin edema and erythema
Granulomatous Lobular Mastitis: Mammography finding: 1.2 cm mass with irregular borders near axillary process of right breast
Physical examination finding: firm mass in upper outer quadrant of right breast
